column1: @ SELECT hex(substr(n.value, 1, 1)) AS h, CAST(c.contributor AS TEXT) AS contributor, c.nightly, c.target, c.result, CAST(c.talon_version AS TEXT) AS talon_version, c.time FROM contributions c JOIN names n ON n.id = c.artifact ORDER BY n.value, c.contributor, c.nightly, c.target

@ SELECT hex(substr(n.value, 1, 1)) AS h, x.nightly, x.target, CAST(x.talon_version AS TEXT) AS talon_version, x.pass_count, x.fail_count, x.crash_count, x.first_time, x.last_time FROM compat_hints x JOIN names n ON n.id = x.artifact ORDER BY n.value, x.nightly, x.target, x.talon_version
@ SELECT day, counted FROM hint_days ORDER BY day
@ SELECT source, count(*) FROM compat GROUP BY source ORDER BY source
